description.narrative: The EBRD invested EUR 90 million in the senior non-preferred ("SNP") public bond issuance of EUR 500 million placed by Banca Transilvania S.A. ("BT"), a commercial bank incorporated in Romania, on 21 April 2023. The bond is listed on the Euronext Dublin Stock Exchange. The EBRD further invested EUR 40 million in a EUR-denominated, senior non-preferred sustainability international bond issuance of EUR 500 million launched by BT on 29 November 2023. The bond is listed on the Euronext Dublin Stock Exchange. The EBRD further invested EUR 30 million in a EUR-denominated, senior non-preferred sustainability international bond issuance of EUR 700 million launched by BT on 25 September 2024. The bond is listed on the Euronext Dublin Stock Exchange. The project contributes to the resilience and compliance with MREL (Minimum Requirements for Own Lending and Eligible Funds) requirements of the largest systemic bank in Romania, facilitates capital market development and further promotes BT's green agenda by supporting the financing of sustainable investments.
